column3: T-This time I must...! I was given a hard time during lunch break but this...!
I'll definitely settle it this time, Kuroneko!
It's useless going to her classroom after all. In that case...
Damn it... if it comes to this...
Excuse me, did Gokou come for club activities recently?
Nope... She hasn't been appearing at the 【Clubroom】 lately...
She always goes home immediately after school, so she should probably be at the 【Shoe Rack】 by now...
Victory! This way, she'll definitely come here!
All I have to do is to wait here.
Yo, I've been waiting for you.
